I5.quote: A high active and stable bifunctional oxygen electrocatalyst of Co–CoO multiphase nanoparticles (NPs) encapsulated in N,S co-doped carbon shells (Co–CoO@NSC) is designed and constructed by in-situ S doping of ZIF-67 with thiourea and subsequent pyrolysis, ...

notes: Oxygen electrocatalyst (ORR/OER) and Zn-air battery paper with no H2 uptake measurement. I1 failure coded no_conditions_stated per the I1 rule: the paper is not computation-only (it has experimental synthesis, N2 physisorption, XPS, electrochemistry), and its electrochemistry is oxygen electrochemistry, not hydrogen charging or hydrogen electrocatalysis, so 'electrochemical' (hydrogen electrochemistry) does not apply literally. The journal's article-type label on p. 1 reads 'Perspective', but the document is in substance an original research article reporting its own data (Sections 2.1-2.5, SI Experimental section), so not_primary was not applied; if the label alone were taken as decisive, not_primary would precede no_conditions_stated. Either way the paper is ineligible. is_retracted is false and the PDF has no retraction notice.
